findings.location: <article> paragraph: "Unfortunately, the opportunity to serve came at a cost." (around the middle)
findings.source_quote: Unfortunately, the opportunity to serve came at a cost. The COs were young and separated from their church and family.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the stray Chinese/Japanese character and render as standard Korean: e.g. "유감스럽게도 그 섬김의 기회는 대가를 치렀다." or better "유감스럽게도 그 섬김의 기회에는 대가가 따랐다." Keep surrounding sentence structure unchanged.
